signature.one_line: Office skit: small two-line set-up text over boss, dropped for a wordless gesture gag.
unique_devices: Small white bold semi-condensed 2-line set-up (situation line + short question) at 17-22 % H over empty wall, only during the first shot
Text pulled off on the first cut: the payoff plays text-free
Spoken question answered by a long wordless low over-the-shoulder wide; a body crossing the lens acts as the closing wipe
signature.why_it_works: Everyone recognises the boss moment from the first raised word; silence and gestures as the answer is the joke.

hook.type: In medias res (raised-voice question + set-up text)
hook.first_frame: boss character at an office desk mid-rant, gesturing, laptop in the foreground; small white 2-line text on the wall above the head

structure.what: boss fires quick questions; set-up text names the situation
hard cut to a low OTS wide: employees answer only with exaggerated gestures, no text
boss stands and follows them out; crossing the lens closes the clip

background_text.how: bold semi-condensed sans ~41 px white, tracking -0.01 em, line 1 centre y 18.4 %, line 2 21.2 %, line pitch 2.8 % H, block centre x ~50.6 %; on from frame 0, hard off with the cut

layout.how: MS of the boss, then low over-the-shoulder wide from the desk; text only on the empty wall band

camera.how: no moves or punch-ins; the wide holds ~78 % of runtime

transitions.how: question asked in shot 1, answered silently in shot 2
a subject crossing close to the lens closes the scene

other_text_spec.type: set-up meme text (no speech captions; the only text)

spec.script: latin (Roman Hinglish on-screen text; speech is Hindi and is NOT captioned)
spec.punctuation: spaced hyphen at the end of line 1 (a dangling connector word + ' -'), question mark at the end

grouping.sync: not tied to speech; on from frame 0, off at the first shot cut
grouping.break: set-up / punchline split: a situation line ending in a spaced hyphen / a short question

layout.note: upper fifth, on the empty wall above the subject's head, slightly left of frame centre (block centre x ~50.6 %)

meme_text.font_class: bold semi-condensed grotesque (narrow letters, short descenders, tight spacing; native in-app text look)

closest_match.note: Anton matches the measured width-to-height ratio but is heavier and more condensed-display; Inter 700 is ~20 % too wide at the same height
closest_match.web_font: Roboto Condensed Bold (letterforms) / Barlow Semi Condensed SemiBold

meme_text.size_note: reference line 2 (3 words, ~15 characters) measured ink 2.19 % H / 24.9 % W; line 1 (~24 characters) ~36 % W

animation.exit: hard off ~4 frames before the first shot cut (~21 % of runtime); the second shot has no text

other_text_spec.text: no captions, logos, watermark or end card (props in the set are part of the footage)

meme_text.closest_local: Anton 400 (a semi-condensed bold grotesque such as Barlow Semi Condensed SemiBold is closer)

style.look_intent: high-contrast, muted, neutral-warm; ungraded cool fluorescent office with bright windows

sound.music: music bed likely (heuristic, ~103 BPM estimate) under the wordless gag; comedic bed

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: an office / team skit with a visual (non-verbal) punchline
Hinglish-speaking audience and a relatable boss or client moment
two static phone set-ups and 2-3 performers
avoid_when: the message must be spoken and captioned
polished brand ads needing logos and end cards
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B24 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B24.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship — text and accent must stay >= 4.5:1 / >= 3:1 against what sits behind them on the footage):
- {{TEXT}}      default #FFFFFF (set-up text)
- {{ACCENT}}    default #FFFFFF (no accent in this style)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  default none
- {{SURFACE}}   default none
- {{CARD_BG}}   default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} default Anton 400 (closer: a bold semi-condensed grotesque such as Barlow Semi Condensed SemiBold)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    default same
- {{HANDLE}}    default @handle
- {{LOGO}}      default the brand's logo file (transparent PNG/SVG)
The text is small and has no shadow: place it on a mid/dark wall area so it stays >= 4.5:1; never add a box.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

CAPTIONS
1. No speech captions.

OTHER TEXT
2. Set-up text, first shot only: 2 centred lines of Roman Hinglish, sentence case — line 1 a situation line ending in a spaced hyphen, line 2 a short question (placeholder 'Headline here -' / 'KEY WORD here?'). {{FONT_DISPLAY}} ~41 px (line 2 ~42 px), {{TEXT}}, tracking -0.01 em, no stroke / shadow / box. Line 1 centre 18.4 % H, line 2 centre 21.2 % H (pitch 2.8 % H), block centre x ~50.6 %, on the empty wall above the head.
3. Timing: on from frame 0 with no animation; hard off ~4 frames before the first cut; the payoff shot has no text.
4. No {{LOGO}}, watermark or end card.
5. Edit: shot 1 = medium shot of the questioner (~22 % of runtime); hard cut mid-question to a static low over-the-shoulder wide held to the end; let a body crossing the lens close it.

GRADE
Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, muted, neutral-warm; natural office light.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render both lines with the placeholders and measure: python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.25,0.165,0.75,0.235 --ink "{{TEXT}}:50"
b) python3 video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "Anton 400" --word "<line 2, lowercase with ascenders>" --ink 2.19 --tracking -0.01 -> ~41-42 px (the reference 3-word line 2 read 24.9 % W; line 1 of ~24 characters ~36 % W at ~40 px). Tolerance ±0.5 % H, ±2 % W. (fit_font.py needs a target: --ink and/or --width; it returns the px that reproduces that ink for YOUR word plus the width it will read at that px. Requires Pillow.)
c) Positions within ±1 % H: line 1 centre 18.4 %, line 2 centre 21.2 %.
